_comment: Served at https://pu-rs.org/v1/news.json — read by Local Mind's Models screen.
mdBook copies non-chapter files under src/ verbatim, so this path IS the URL.
· Curated, first-party only. Nothing user-authored, so App Review 1.2 does not attach.
· NEVER a price. An item may carry ticker/tickerURL, which the app renders as a LINK
to the source's page; redistributing quotes carries exchange terms, linking does not.
· The app shows at most 5 items and re-checks at most twice an hour (ttlMinutes is a
server hint; the client floor is 30 minutes and wins if this is lower).
· kind is one of ai | market | release and only picks the leading glyph.
· published is optional — omit it rather than guess a date.
Every url here was checked to return 200 before it was added. Keep doing that.
